selection: All 50 datasets per n in the same balanced varsel=FALSE subsets; n=40 balanced_ablation, n>=80 balanced_main.
h_indices: All observation indices 1 through n; joint draws per retained iteration
postprocess: bkmr::SamplePred, Znew=selected observed Z, Xnew=zero, type=link, sel=5001:10000 explicitly; separate seed per chain; restore RNG after postprocessing.
primary: Unchanged six parameters, Rhat <=1.01, bulk ESS>=400, tail ESS>=400.
scope: 200 original FALSE tasks, all observed h values. TRUE is not rerun.
retention: All point diagnostics and six core plus five fixed-point draw matrices only; full h and ystar histories discarded after in-memory diagnostics.
validation: Six original core draws exact reproduction and 30 original entries. First six completed tasks passed independent first-draw verification. Subsequent tasks use independent conditional mean/covariance verification plus exact package-draw replay, because near-singular full-point covariances amplify rounding differences in matrix roots. Full chain alignment and finite diagnostics; final recheck of retained five.
analysis: All-point and nested fixed-five descriptive diagnostics by n and original primary status. All-point pass is supplementary, not a replacement primary criterion. No h accuracy or scientific-contrast accuracy claim.
